summary: Baileys fork sends data to char-code-obfuscated external host at https://fiora.nixel.my.id/
details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. In lib/Socket/messages-send.js at lines 425 and 436, a network destination is reconstructed at runtime from a String.fromCharCode(...) decimal-code array that decodes to the host https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The obfuscated destination is not part of the upstream Baileys API surface and is not a WhatsApp endpoint; the char-code encoding is used specifically to hide the hostname from casual inspection of the source. This host is contacted from a WhatsApp client library that handles session credentials, message content, and account identity, and the same file (messages-send.js) is on the outbound-message code path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
